title: deparia auriculata
intro: Deparia auriculata, commonly known as the auriculated lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Deparia auriculata include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The bioactive constituents of Deparia auriculata also exhibit anti-cancer and neuroprotective activities, making it a subject of interest for further research.
